kind: Generated editorial collage using owner-provided film footage
prompt:
Create an exceptional designed 16:9 landscape website film cover for Taalcut's launch film "Zero posts." Target 1920 x 1080. This should look like confident editorial film key art by a human graphic designer: compelling high contrast typography, carefully cut real photography, intentional overlays; NOT generic AI poster art.

Reference images 1, 2, 3 are actual shots from the film, of the same traveller walking away in Vietnam. Preserve their photographic details, places, natural lighting and people. Use these actual photos as the collage material, do not invent new scenery or faces. Image 4 is the official white Taalcut logo; use it faithfully as a small upper-left signature, never redesign or retype it.

Concept: "a full camera roll, nothing posted." Matte near-black charcoal background, very subtle print texture. On left 52%, oversized tightly set heavy contemporary grotesk typography like Onest, four visible exact text elements:
- logo upper left
- a modest but legible uppercase kicker "1,284 CLIPS."
- main title "ZERO" on one line and "POSTS." underneath, huge, off-white, occupying left central area
- one smaller line at lower left "THE LAUNCH FILM"
Main title needs excellent mobile thumbnail readability. NO other words, UI, labels, or fine print.

On the right, a beautifully art-directed stack of three overlapping tall photographic contact prints with crisp narrow off-white borders, slight expressive rotations, casting natural tiny contact shadows. Lantern street (reference 1) is largest in front, temple (reference 3) behind top-right, the poolside walk (reference 2) behind lower-left. Let largest photograph's upper corner reach near top. Photos should occupy roughly 44% of canvas, large and legible; not a grid of tiny thumbnails. Preserve photo reality.

Overlay language: a single broad imperfect rose-red grease-pencil ellipse circling just "ZERO"; a marigold curved drawn arrow sweeping from the photo pile toward the title without crossing letters; precise teal crop corner marks bracketing the front photo; a tiny strip of translucent beige tape securing a photo edge. Use asymmetry and controlled overlap. No starbursts, no glow, no purple gradients, no chrome/3D blobs, no fake app windows, no invented phone mockup. Graphic marks should feel purposeful and tactile, stylish rather than messy. Title should remain clear.
Keep bottom 18% at center and bottom-right largely quiet charcoal: the website will render its REAL play button there. Do not bake any play icon/button or duration into this artwork. Comfortable safe margins around type. Final image flat artwork, edge-to-edge, no surrounding frame/mockup.
